programme.title: Crayon Shinchan the Movie: Super-Hot! The Spicy Kasukabe Dancers
programme.desc: To commemorate the sister city relationship between Kasukabe and Mushibai Hagashimiru in India, the 'Kasukabe Children's Carnival' was held. Word spread that winning the carnival's dance competition would earn a trip to India. Shin-chan, alongside with his trusty Kasukabe friends lit up the stage with a spectacular performance, clinching the championship and setting off for the curry-scented and starlit wonders of India! But little did they know, a thrilling adventure had beguan. During their India journey, Shin-chan and Bo-chan wandered into a shady general store and bought a peculiar nose-shaped backpack, unaware of its dark secret. Disaster struck when Bo-chan accidentally stuffed a mysterious slip of paper from the backpack in his nose, unleashing an evil force that transformed him into “Tyrant” Bo-chan, a rampaging villain with the power to destroy the world! With Bo-chan's personality warped and his actions spiralling out of control, can Shin-chan and his friends harnes

programme.title: Hokusai
programme.desc: In the Edo-era, young impecunious artist Katsushika Hokusai lived in downtown Edo. He was shabby and lived from hand to mouth with little money he earned by selling his painting on the streets. But Tsutaya Juzaburo, the one of a kind publisher, discovered Hokusai's hidden talent and led him to unleash his potentials. With Juzaburo's help, Hokusai found the essence of drawing and his talent bloomed. Meanwhile, the entertainment ban came in effect by the Edo shogunate. While Hokusai became older, he built a strong relationship with Ryutei Tanehiko, the popular playwright, who was born as a samurai and was distressed in creating new plays because of the prohibition. Eventually Tanehiko got executed by the shogunate. Hokusai came out with all his repulsion against the Edo shogunate on his vivid drawings.

programme.title: Small, Slow but Steady
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name
programme.desc: Set in a bustling alleyway during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in the 1940s, the film centres on a wife, Zhan Zhou, who was being charged with the bloody dismemberment of her husband – a killing that seems impossible for her to have committed alone. The murder thrusts Zhan into the spotlight and the court of public opinion, forcing her towards a fate intertwined with that of her own country.

programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers make mealtime a delicious discovery. Through stories and songs, kids explore the joy of eating, practice mealtime routines, and learn when to use forks and spoons.

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

They each build castles that get bigger & sillier, & after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet & sing 'If You're Happy & You Know It'!

programme.title: E434
programme.desc: C'EST LA VIE: C'est La Vie focuses on the real experiences of ordinary people amid the tide of the times. Through in-depth interviews and observational filming, it presents a vivid social visual archive of contemporary China with authentic life stories. With profound humanistic care and compelling narrative tension, it has earned widespread acclaim and numerous awards both at home and abroad, establishing itself as a benchmark in Chinese-language documentaries. Continuously conveying warmth and strength, it inspires viewers to reflect deeply on humanity and destiny.

programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina...

programme.title: E43
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E43
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E26 - 男嘉賓街舞說唱點燃全場
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: E12 - 余宇涵體驗帶娃累到想變回小孩
programme.desc: 由伊能靜擔任團長，董璇、喬杉、李嘉格、余宇涵、沈奕斐等擔任觀察員，以「爸爸圖鑑」為主題，通過展現不同家庭的相處模式，聚焦三位背景各異、育兒方式不同的父親，記錄他們真實的帶娃日常，展現多元的家庭教育模式與溫馨的成長故事。

programme.title: E4 - 秦昊深情回望前女友
programme.desc: 由秦昊、大張偉、高瀚宇、顏人中、徐志勝、田嘉瑞組成「高能抽風團」，他們將與好友奔赴海南入住吹風小屋，以「減法生活」開啟一段旅行體驗；通過任務挑戰與即興遊戲贏取生活物資，徹底拋開偶像包袱，呈現最真實的互動與眾多「抽風」瞬間。

programme.title: E5 - 小孩哥含淚答題感動張雨綺
programme.desc: 百位少年齊聚一堂，智慧與勇氣同時接受考驗，黃聖依、黃子弘凡、龐博、張雨綺、李雪琴、陳銘等嘉賓將一直陪伴，引領他們突破自我；到底誰能突破第一道考驗，順利進入組隊資格賽？誰又將通過豐富知識儲備量「站」到最後？一同見證智慧賽場的巔峰瞬間吧！

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾。

programme.title: E5

programme.title: E3 - Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree’s clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: E2 - Otago Peninsula/ Muaupoko
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand’s Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists following their every move. Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys – mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice. After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs. Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”. Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol

programme.title: E3 - Dam Collapses
programme.desc: Dams are among the most powerful and essential engineering structures in the world—but when they fail, the consequences are devastating. This episode uncovers the hidden dangers behind historic dam collapses, from poor planning and unchecked pressure to overlooked maintenance. Through dramatic reconstructions and expert interviews, we explore how these failures flooded entire regions, took countless lives, and transformed global dam safety regulations.
